protected_invariants.heading: Purpose
protected_invariants.text: Use this only after there is an existing PR/MR review thread, inline comment, requested-change discussion, or explicit reviewer note to address. If the user has not received review feedback yet and wants a quality gate before committing or pushing, use `engos-quality-code-review` instead.

protected_invariants.heading: Primary Objective
protected_invariants.text: Read open review comments from a PR/MR, present them to the user, apply the requested changes with minimal scope, and prepare a commit with only the reviewer-requested fixes.

protected_invariants.heading: Choose the Right Review Capability
protected_invariants.text: | "Address only comments 2 and 4" | `engos-delivery-address-code-review` | selected-comment implementation with narrow scope |

protected_invariants.heading: Choose the Right Review Capability
protected_invariants.text: Do not use `engos-delivery-address-code-review` to proactively improve code, clean up adjacent issues, or review a diff before a reviewer has commented. It should only mutate files that are tied to selected review feedback.

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - forbidden: modifying code that has no associated review comment, silent bulk refactors, resolving comments without applying the fix

protected_invariants.heading: 3. Present the comments
protected_invariants.text: Do not edit files until the selected comment set is clear.

protected_invariants.heading: 5. Commit and push
protected_invariants.text: - Stage only the files that were modified to address comments.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - **Only modify code that has an associated review comment.** Do not touch other changed lines in the diff that have no comments.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not resolve/close review threads programmatically — let the reviewer verify.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not mix unrelated changes into the fix commit.

protected_invariants.heading: Evaluation Rubric
protected_invariants.text: | Scope discipline | Only reviewer-requested changes are made, nothing else |

protected_invariants.heading: Evaluation Rubric
protected_invariants.text: | Commit hygiene | Fix commit contains only the review-related changes |
